ticks.note: Deferred entry into the superstate `Inside`. Every transition into `Inside` is deferred, so KIELER postpones the whole entry by a tick: nothing inside happens yet.
`Inside` is really entered now: the entry action of the inner initial state `First` runs (`innerEntry` = 1). `Inside`'s own entry action never runs.
`First`'s delayed transition fires (`step` = 1), one tick later than after a normal entry.
